claims.evidence: Witness report does not include brand/model markings or screen size; only a large flat-screen TV with black bezel is described.
Witness says screen is off/reflective; no powered-on close-up or test pattern was shown.
Witness report does not show the TV powered on; lines/dead pixels require a display test.
Remote control and accessories were explicitly not shown in the witness observations.
No service history, inspection sticker, or internal/serial verification was provided in the witness report.

risks.risk: TV may not power on or may have display faults (blank screen, backlight failure, flicker) since no picture test was shown.
risks.proof: A short video clip of the TV powering on and showing a clear home screen/menu (with brightness up) plus a channel/app screen.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working / untested display until a power-on picture test is provided.

risks.risk: Screen defects (dead pixels, lines, discoloration) cannot be confirmed because the screen was off/reflective.
risks.proof: Close-up powered-on test (solid colors: red/green/blue/white/black) showing no dead pixels or lines.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case for possible panel issues (as-is, unverified panel condition).

risks.risk: Brand/model and exact size may be different from the seller’s claim, affecting value.
risks.proof: Photo of the TV label/serial/model number on the back or side, and a shot showing the screen size (or model specs).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic large flat-screen TV with unknown brand/model.

risks.risk: Accessories may be missing (remote, stand/legs, wall mount, cables), reducing usability.
risks.proof: Photo/video showing all included items laid out: remote, stand/legs or wall mount, power cable, and any other accessories.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming remote/accessories are not included.

risks.risk: Ports/inputs may be faulty (HDMI/USB/power), or connectivity may not work.
risks.proof: Clip showing HDMI input working (e.g., phone/laptop screen on TV) and at least one USB playback test.

risks.risk: Physical condition may be worse than described (cracks, screen damage, bezel damage) since only an off/reflective view was reported.
risks.proof: Multiple photos of the screen and bezel under normal room light and at an angle (no glare), plus corners/edges close-ups.
risks.if_unproven: Price as possible cosmetic/structural damage until close-up condition is confirmed.

proof_requests: Power-on video showing the TV displaying a clear menu/home screen (not just reflections).
Powered-on test images (solid colors) to confirm no dead pixels and no lines.
Photo of the back/side label with brand, model number, serial number, and power rating.
Photos/video of the remote control and all accessories included (stand/legs or wall mount, power cable, etc.).
Short HDMI test clip (phone/laptop connected) to confirm ports work.
response.reason: The witness confirms only that it is a large flat-screen TV with the screen off; key value drivers (brand/model/size, panel health, remote/accessories, and power-on functionality) are not verifiable from the report. A power-on display test and label/accessory proof are needed before pricing confidently.
